name: Do M Imouto no Roshutsu Yuugi ~Dare ni mo Ienai Himitsu no Asobi~
original_name: ドM妹の露出遊戯 ～誰にも言えない秘密の遊び～
source:
My little sister, Miku, is friendly, flawlessly beautiful, and has excellent grades.
There's no end to her good points; she's truly beautiful and intelligent.
But one day, I discovered a shocking secret.
(You've got to be kidding me... that Miku...!)
Miku had uploaded a video of herself masturbating in my room to a video sharing website.
Why was Miku filming herself masturbating?
Why was it filmed in my room?
All sorts of thoughts flooded my mind, making it a mess.
I considered calling Miku and asking her directly.
But asking her, "Were you masturbating in my room?" would undoubtedly create an awkward atmosphere.
"In that case, there's really only one way to find out the truth.
That's right... I just need to capture the moment Miku enters my room.
translation:
我的妹妹美九，性格友善，美丽无瑕，成绩优异。
她的优点数不胜数；她确实美丽又聪明。
但有一天，我发现了一个令人震惊的秘密。
（你一定是在开玩笑吧……那个Miku……！）
Miku将她在我房间自慰的视频上传到视频共享网站。
Miku为什么要拍摄自己自慰的镜头？
为什么要在我的房间里拍摄？
各种想法涌上心头，一片混乱。
我考虑给Miku打电话直接问她。
但问她：“你在我的房间里自慰吗？”无疑会造成一种尴尬的气氛。
“在这种情况下，真的只有一种方法可以查明真相。
是的……我只要捕捉到Miku进入我房间的那一刻就可以了。”
